in_use_evidence: Code (DefinitionStoreService._require_publishable_drafts, test_publication_routes.py:298) builds the REQUIRED problem form, the other side of the TASK_DRAFT_INVALID text; no code builds TASK_DRAFT_INVALID. why: A nameless draft gets REQUIRED in one Scenario and TASK_DRAFT_INVALID in another, so the author of the next check writes tests that contradict one of them.
rule_gap: Option 2 of the Fix replaces no built text but relabels it as delivered code; 'text that the Fix replaces' in case 2 (built) does not say whether a relabel counts.
